entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah... I hope you can help. I need to return something, and I'm just so disappointed about it. I've been a VeloFit customer for years.
I'm sorry to hear that you're disappointed. I can certainly look into a return for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-886-2145. It's for a jersey I bought a little while ago. I was so excited for it, but... it's just not right.

Okay, one moment. I'm pulling up order VF-886-2145. I see the Aero-Vent Pro jersey, delivered about two months ago. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's just the wrong size. I saved up for this specific jersey, and it's just too tight across the shoulders. I feel terrible about it, but I can't wear it. I was going to see about an exchange, but honestly, I really need the money back right now.
I understand. Getting the right fit is crucial for performance and comfort. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.
Oh, I hope so. I know it's been a little while, I've just had a lot going on. It would really help me out.

Okay, I've reviewed your order and our policy. Good news! Since the jersey is a standard item, it's still well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much, Sarah. You have no idea what a help that is.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could help. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you again. You've made my day!
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
